name: A Moon-Kissed Blade
summary: Trevan warns that the worgen threaten Silverpine Forest and names Old Fire-Eye as a foe who resists death through unknown magic. He asks you to learn what is needed for a special blade.

sections.title: A smith's list
sections.body: Old Fire-Eye is the worgen who attacked Trevan and his companions. Trevan will give you a list of the materials needed to forge a weapon against him. The materials are gathered, and Trevan believes he knows a smith who can craft the blade.

faq.answer: Old Fire-Eye is the largest and meanest of the worgen, and he attacked Trevan and his companions.

faq.q: Why does Old Fire-Eye keep coming back?
faq.answer: Unknown magic keeps Old Fire-Eye from staying dead.

faq.q: What does Trevan need from me?
faq.answer: Trevan will give you a list of materials needed to forge a special weapon.

faq.q: Why is a special blade needed?
faq.answer: Old Fire-Eye resists death through unknown magic, so Trevan says a special weapon is needed to put him down.
Trevan believes he knows a smith who can craft the blade.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Moon-Kissed Blade
